customManagers.description: Update default values in Flux variable substitution OCI refs like ref.tag: ${VAR:-v1.2.3}
Update default image tags in Flux patches like image: ghcr.io/org/app:${VAR:-v1.2.3}

Update HelmRelease chart.spec.version defaults behind Flux variable substitution. The flux manager skips these as contains-variable, so the datasource/registry is supplied by a preceding renovate comment.

Update chart-version defaults threaded into a bundle's child Kustomization, e.g. infra/platform's `CERT_MANAGER_VERSION: "${CERT_MANAGER_VERSION:-v1.21.1}"` inside postBuild.substitute. These are a second copy of the base's default (a child CR cannot inherit it — an empty substitute value renders as YAML null and the API server rejects the CR), so they must be bumped in the same PR as the base or the bundle silently pins the old version.

packageRules.description: Group all stuttgart-things first-party images into a single PR

Group each homerun2 component on its own, so a component's image and its -kustomize artifact are always bumped in the same PR and cannot drift apart (see #208). Overrides the broad stuttgart-things grouping above.
Auto-merge patch and digest updates once CI passes — keeps low-risk bumps from piling up
Flag major updates for manual review; never auto-merge
